correctness.rationale: All n and c are proved by the exact Q(6h+j) table and the complete identity (1). For gcd(c,6)=1, every six-step block contributes exactly 1 and the unique negative partial sum is a one-entry walk at residue zero; the last zero is exactly n=7c-7 or 7c-5 and c=1 is separate. For gcd(c,6)>1, the 6-step sum is -6,-3,or -2 and produces a strict decrease for every n=6kc. Exact independent DP verifies 408502 identities/comparisons but universal proof is analytic.

value.rationale: The last index at which a representation count fails to increase is a natural, exact local-growth invariant not supplied by polynomial asymptotics; it is classified sharply for every parameter c. The result also gives an exact arithmetic dichotomy between eventual strict growth and infinitely recurring strict declines, establishing a structural boundary, rather than an isolated small enumeration.
